backstory.text: Was late to the interview.
Asked when payday is, then asked again.
Says he understands. He does not understand.
Asked whether dying hurts. Was not joking.
Keeps a written record of every night he sat out.
Passes on upgrades without being asked.
Talks about going home a lot.
Asked whether dying hurts. Was not joking.
Refuses to speak to Mages.
Has strong opinions about being hit, all of them wrong.
Insists he is a tank. He is not.
Died standing in the fire, and has questions for the Cleric.
Keeps a written record of every night he sat out.
Says he was not healed. He was healed.
Insists he is a tank. He is not.
Has died more times than he can count and finds that funny.
Arrives as the pull starts. Every time.
Openly here for the gear. Says so in the interview.
Has a long-standing grievance with Druids. Will explain it.
Describes his best night to anyone who stands still.
Goes very quiet for a day after a bad night.
Made a comment about the boots. It was not kind.
Has never once been on time, and is always surprised.
Checks the healing numbers before checking his own.

lines:
[R06] Dave MISTAKE · Moderate · Healed the Wrong Target (after start_08:r6:MIS_AGGRO, depth 2)
      "Dave put the slow heal on the raider who is about to be fine and the fast one on nobody."

[R07] Pauline MISTAKE · Severe · Pulled Aggro Off the Tank
      "Pauline was behind the boss, technically, right up until the boss stopped being where it was."

[R07] Yvonne MISTAKE · Minor · Attacked the Wrong Target
      "Yvonne was told to focus the marked one and has focused the one closest to being marked."

[R07] Nigel MISTAKE · Severe · Healed the Wrong Target (after start_06:r7:MIS_AGGRO, depth 1)
      "Nigel set the totem down beside somebody lovely and entirely out of the way."

[R08] Pauline MISTAKE · Severe · Facepulled the Next Group (after start_06:r7:MIS_AGGRO, depth 1)
      "Pauline thought the group was already pulled and helpfully confirmed it."

[R08] Yvonne MISTAKE · Minor · Attacked the Wrong Target (after start_07:r7:MIS_WRONG_TARGET, depth 1)
      "Yvonne is very confident about which one is the dangerous one, and very wrong."

[R08] Steve MISTAKE · Minor · Attacked the Wrong Target (after start_08:r1:MIS_BROKE_CC, depth 1)
      "Steve is attacking the thing that is attacking Steve, which is a rule from a different game."

[R08] Dave MISTAKE · Minor · Healed the Wrong Target (after start_06:r7:MIS_AGGRO, depth 1)
      "Dave picked a name off the list, and the list is sorted alphabetically."

[R08] Janice MISTAKE · Minor · Started an Argument in Raid Chat
      "Janice is arguing about a wipe from three weeks ago that Janice has clearly not let go of."

[R09] Gary MISTAKE · Moderate · Pulled Aggro Off the Tank
      "Gary is now the most interesting person in the room and would very much like to stop being that."

[R09] Dave MISTAKE · Severe · Healed the Wrong Target (after start_09:r9:MIS_AGGRO, depth 1)
      "Dave got there first, which counts for something, and healed the wrong person, which counts for less."

[R09] Bob MISTAKE · Severe · Went AFK (after start_01:r8:MIS_ARGUMENT, depth 1)
      "Bob was here at the pull and is a rumour by round four."
[R09] Bob has wandered off for three rounds.

[R09] Brenda MISTAKE · Severe · Started an Argument in Raid Chat (after start_00:r9:MIS_AFK, depth 2)
      "Brenda corrected somebody's pronunciation of the boss's name and the room turned."

[R09] Dave MISTAKE · Severe · Went AFK (after start_00:r9:MIS_AFK, depth 2)
      "Dave is standing perfectly still with the calm of somebody who has gone to answer the door."
[R09] Dave has wandered off for three rounds.

[R10] Janice MISTAKE · Moderate · Forgot to Taunt (after start_01:r8:MIS_ARGUMENT, depth 1)
      "Janice counted to three and waited for the other tank's nod, and the other tank was counting too."

[R10] Dave MISTAKE · Severe · Started an Argument in Raid Chat (after start_01:r10:MIS_TAUNT_LAPSE, depth 2)
      "Dave has raised a point about loot distribution, and has raised it now."

[R10] Nigel MISTAKE · Severe · Started an Argument in Raid Chat (after start_01:r10:MIS_TAUNT_LAPSE, depth 2)
      "Nigel has asked who is in charge here, which is a fair question, badly timed."

[R10] Steve MISTAKE · Minor · Started an Argument in Raid Chat (after start_03:r10:MIS_ARGUMENT, depth 3)
      "Steve is explaining, at length, what should have happened on round two."

[R11] Janice MISTAKE · Minor · Forgot to Taunt (after start_01:r10:MIS_TAUNT_LAPSE, depth 2)
      "Janice was mid-sentence about last week's wipe when the round came round again."

[R11] Brenda MISTAKE · Severe · Healed the Wrong Target (after start_01:r11:MIS_TAUNT_LAPSE, depth 3)
      "Brenda healed the raider who asked, rather than the one who is too busy to ask."

[R11] Steve MISTAKE · Moderate · Started an Argument in Raid Chat (after start_03:r10:MIS_ARGUMENT, depth 3)
      "Steve would like everybody to know who pulled that, and everybody now does."

[R12] Pauline MISTAKE · Critical · Pulled Aggro Off the Tank (after start_06:r8:MIS_FACEPULL, depth 2)
      "Pauline was told to hold back until the tank had it, held back for one round, and decided that was long enough."

[R12] Brenda MISTAKE · Minor · Healed a Corpse (after start_06:r12:MIS_AGGRO, depth 3)
      "Brenda is doing everything right for somebody it is too late to do anything for."

[R12] Nigel MISTAKE · Severe · Went AFK (after start_06:r12:MIS_AGGRO, depth 3)
      "Nigel is not here. Nigel's body is here."
[R12] Nigel has wandered off for three rounds.

[R12] Greg MISTAKE · Minor · Went AFK
      "Greg is reading something. It is not the fight."
[R12] Greg has wandered off for a round.

[R13] Bob MISTAKE · Severe · Forgot to Taunt
      "Bob had one job this round and got absorbed in a different, more interesting job."

[R13] Janice MISTAKE · Moderate · Forgot to Taunt (after start_01:r11:MIS_TAUNT_LAPSE, depth 3)
      "Janice looked over at the boss, decided it seemed settled, and let it settle."

[R13] Yvonne MISTAKE · Severe · Facepulled the Next Group (after start_07:r8:MIS_WRONG_TARGET, depth 2)
      "Yvonne moved before the call, because waiting had started to feel like standing around."

[R13] Brenda MISTAKE · Moderate · Healed the Wrong Target (after start_00:r13:MIS_TAUNT_LAPSE, depth 1)
      "Brenda healed a tank, just not the tank that was being hit."

[R13] Dave MISTAKE · Severe · Healed the Wrong Target (after start_00:r13:MIS_TAUNT_LAPSE, depth 1)
      "Dave is topping up the raider who is fine, because the one who is not fine is hard to look at."

[R14] Janice MISTAKE · Moderate · Forgot to Taunt
      "Janice assumed the boss had understood the arrangement."

[R14] Pauline MISTAKE · Severe · Facepulled the Next Group (after start_06:r8:MIS_FACEPULL, depth 2)
      "Pauline stepped forward to check something and checked it thoroughly."

[R14] Yvonne MISTAKE · Moderate · Pulled Aggro Off the Tank (after start_07:r13:MIS_FACEPULL, depth 3)
      "Yvonne assumed the tank would take it back, and the tank assumed Yvonne had a plan."

[R14] Pauline MISTAKE · Moderate · Went AFK (after start_06:r14:MIS_FACEPULL, depth 3)
      "Pauline stepped away for one moment, at the start of a fight that has moments in it."
[R14] Pauline has wandered off for two rounds.

[R15] Bob MISTAKE · Minor · Forgot to Taunt (after start_00:r13:MIS_TAUNT_LAPSE, depth 1)
      "Bob refuses to yield the front, and also refuses to say anything while standing on it."

[R15] Yvonne MISTAKE · Severe · Facepulled the Next Group (after start_07:r13:MIS_FACEPULL, depth 3)
      "Yvonne wanted a look at the next group, and the next group is now getting a look at us."

[R15] Yvonne MISTAKE · Moderate · Started an Argument in Raid Chat (after start_07:r13:MIS_FACEPULL, depth 3)
      "Yvonne brought up the seating plan for the guild dinner, mid-pull."
[R15] No healers left and the boss is barely scratched. The raid calls it.
[R15] It traces back to Pauline — Facepulled the Next Group, round 14.
